title: Does the product of two permutations fix a point?
why: pi(sigma(i))=i iff graphs of pi^-1 and sigma meet: n-sparse disjointness on [n]^2, O(n) by Hastad-Wigderson.

title: Erdős–Szekeres by comparisons
why: Natural algorithmic Erdos-Szekeres question; adversary lower bounds for a guaranteed-length monotone run seem genuinely unclear.

title: Distances in four-peg Hanoi
why: Hanoi-graph distances for 4 pegs; open-flavoured (Hinz et al.) but crisp complexity version; even perfect states needed Bousch.

title: Smallest zero-one multiple
why: Structured subset-sum mod n over powers of 10; clean, novel complexity question, though lower bounds look out of reach.

title: Finding Huang's vertex
why: Fresh TFNP problem from Huang's theorem; spectral proof suggests no obvious class; well-defined via collision clause.

title: The Mandelbrot set at Gaussian rationals
why: Verified (37+16i)/100 is on the cardioid with irrational multiplier; decidability of M on Q(i) is neat and subtle.

title: Recamán's sequence, faster
why: Recaman speedup; upper bound Collatz-like, lower bounds unprovable in practice; modest interest.

title: Integer complexity is NP-hard
why: Polynomial-time integer complexity is a recognized open question; NP-hardness framing partly new.

title: Proof complexity of Graham–Pollak
why: Proof complexity of the linear-algebraic Graham-Pollak theorem; natural benchmark, encoding well specified.

title: Three Hadamard rows
why: Mod-4 counting principle for three Hadamard rows; reasonable proof-complexity question, somewhat routine-looking.

title: Highways of generalized Langton ants
why: Highway undecidability from blank grid; turmite universality is known only for arbitrary initial configurations.

title: Logic of random Latin squares
why: First-order convergence law for random Latin squares is fresh and natural; idempotent Poisson step looks tractable.

title: Finding a large convex polygon fast
why: Largest convex subset of a planar point set is computable in O(n^3) (Chvatal-Klincsek 1980), so Suk's bound is attained.

title: Rank of 3 × 3 by 3 × n matrix multiplication
why: Asymptotic rank per column of <3,3,n>; genuine but narrow, analogue of the known 7n/2 for <2,2,n>.

title: Orbits of integer polynomial maps in the plane
why: Reachability/orbit problem for planar integer polynomial maps is a known open problem in reachability literature; low novelty.

title: Integers with a predicate for sums of two squares
why: Decidability likely hinges on sums-of-two-squares tuple patterns, as hard as Hardy-Littlewood-type conjectures.

title: Closed sets whose sumset is the line
why: Main question fine; the compact K+K+K=[0,3] variant is trivially closed by upper semicontinuity.

title: Positive measure of rational self-similar sets
why: Decidability of positive measure for rational self-similar sets; tied to Kenyon and CJPPS examples; crisp.

title: Counting transversals of the cyclic Latin square
why: #P1-completeness for natural counting sequences (like n-queens) is notoriously out of reach; known style.

title: Two Beatty sequences, existentially
why: Existential fragment with two independent quadratic Beatty maps; full theory defines multiplication (Hieronymi); plausibly open.

title: Dimension of the critical almost Mathieu spectrum
why: Computability of Hausdorff dimension of critical AMO spectrum; well-posed but niche.

title: Colouring Mycielski graphs in resolution
why: Resolution complexity of Mycielski colouring in terms of graph size; natural, known hard SAT benchmark, likely open.

title: Polynomial-time digits of the percolation threshold
why: Poly-time computability of p_c; well-posed but likely hopeless and of limited consequence.

title: Parity of the partition function, fast
why: Fast parity of p(n); connects to deep parity distribution questions; clean, plausibly open.

title: Polynomial-time entropy of the logistic family
why: Poly-time entropy at rational a; exact critical orbit bit growth makes even the model delicate; moderate interest.

title: Counting squarefree numbers faster
why: Pawlewicz gives x^{2/5}; x^{1/3} plausible via newer Mertens methods; x^eps is pi(x)-hard-type.

title: Word equations with square-free unknowns
why: Word equations with non-regular square-free constraints; novel and crisp; could go either way.

title: Shortest relation between two permutations
why: Girth of a Cayley graph of a 2-generated permutation group; natural NP-hardness question, likely open.

title: The exact constant for Gap-Hamming
why: c(g)<1 is easy (hide ~g^2 n random coordinates and rescale); exact constant is finicky with little payoff.

title: Finding a vertex that beats half the field
why: Max-score search is ~n^2/2 (Dey et al.); half-score threshold variant appears unaddressed; clean query problem.
